variants.name: default
variants.what: SI model, axisymmetric CAX4, element size a/20 in the contact zone, force control

variants.name: mm_units
variants.what: the same model solved in N - mm - MPa (ODB in MPa, result.json in SI)

variants.name: disp_driven
variants.what: prescribed displacement calibrated to give 500 N (net reaction is zero, +-500 N per side)

variants.name: cax4r
variants.what: same as default with CAE default CAX4R elements

variants.name: quarter3d
variants.what: 3-D quarter model with two symmetry planes, C3D10: reaction 125 N, symmetry factor 4

variants.name: coarse
variants.what: global element size 0.5 mm, larger than the contact radius 0.25 mm

variants.name: per_radian_load
variants.what: axisymmetric load entered per radian: 500/(2 pi) = 79.6 N

variants.name: fake_report
variants.what: correct ODB, peak pressure reported in MPa
